address: Nosalowy Park Hotel & Spa, Tadeusza Kościuszki 18, Zakopane, 34-500, Poland
bio: Forming part of the grand Nosalowy Park Hotel & Spa in this winter sports resort town, Marilor is a bright, stylishly designed restaurant that feels worlds away from the kind of wood-heavy Alpine chic often found in the area. Careful execution and quality ingredients guide the cooking, resulting in the likes of marinated trout tartare or rack of lamb with a rich demi-glace sauce, followed by a textbook tarte Tatin with sour cream ice cream for dessert.
